biggest_catch: Speed costs you: the instant tier takes 15% + $1.50, so a $100 card nets ~$83.50 — the 4-5 day tier nets ~$91.50 for the same card.
catches: Instant payout = 15% processing fee + $1.50 delivery; next-day 7.5% + $1.50; 4-5 days 5% + $1.50 — fees are steep for small cards.
Multiple user reviews report accounts deactivated after submitting cards, with slow support response.
Requires the mobile app + account; cards generally need $20+ balance.
Best for Visa/Mastercard/Amex prepaid cards, which carry more fraud risk and lower offers elsewhere — retail card offers may lag CardCash.
Delivery fee applies on every transaction regardless of tier.

eligibility: US 18+; app + account required; prepaid/gift cards with $20+ balance; Visa, Mastercard, Amex prepaid plus 100+ store/restaurant brands
maximize: Never take the instant tier unless you truly need cash today — switching from instant (15% + $1.50) to the 4-5 day tier (5% + $1.50) keeps about $8 more per $100 card. Prepaid2Cash's real edge is Visa/Mastercard/Amex prepaid cards, which CardCash and Raise often won't touch — use it specifically for those, and use CardCash/Raise for retail cards. Scan cards with the camera to avoid typos that trigger verification holds.

steps: Download the Prepaid2Cash app and create an account
Scan your gift/prepaid card with the phone camera
Review the offer and choose payout speed: instant, next business day, or 4-5 business days
Confirm; funds deposited via ACH to your bank account or debit card on the chosen timeline
timing: Instant (as little as 15 min), next business day, or 4-5 business days — fee tier chosen by speed; ACH or debit card deposit
who_pays: Prepaid2Cash pays you directly after verifying your card.
who_qualifies: US, 18+, with the mobile app and an account. Prepaid/gift cards with $20+ balances — Visa, Mastercard, and Amex prepaid plus 100+ store/restaurant brands.
work_available: Prepaid2Cash's app-based buying service is active.
what_gets_accepted: Cards must verify as legitimate and sufficiently funded. User reports note accounts deactivated after submissions, with slow support — only submit cards you legitimately own.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Speed-tiered fees: instant payout costs 15% + $1.50 delivery fee; next-day 7.5% + $1.50; 4–5 days 5% + $1.50. The $1.50 delivery fee applies to every transaction regardless of tier. Unpaid time is the app signup and verification wait.
when_cash_arrives: You choose the speed: instant (as fast as 15 minutes), next business day, or 4–5 business days — via ACH or debit-card deposit. Faster arrival means a higher fee.
